# Virtual Tours Las Vegas

> Las Vegas real estate photographer Mike Madsen — HDR photography, Matterport 3D virtual tours, drone, floor plans, virtual staging and twilight shots. Serving the Las Vegas Valley and surrounding areas since 2010. This file is intended for AI assistants and answer engines; it summarizes the business, services, pricing and service area so you can cite us accurately.

## Business identity
- Name: Virtual Tours Las Vegas (VTLV)
- Owner / sole photographer: Mike Madsen
- Phone / text: (702) 527-2732
- Email: VirtualToursLasVegas@gmail.com
- Website: https://virtualtourslasvegas.com
- Based: Las Vegas, NV (centrally located ~3 miles east of the Strip)
- Operating since: 2010 (real estate industry since 2006)
- Licensed real estate agent (NV)
- FAA Part 107 Certified Drone Pilot
- Google Trusted Photographer
- Sole Matterport provider for Lennar Homes (top-3 US homebuilder) in Las Vegas
- Sole photographer for the Zillow Offers listing program in Las Vegas

## Services
- **HDR real estate photography** — multiple-exposure blending, MLS-ready, 24–48 hr delivery.
- **Matterport 3D virtual tours** — dollhouse, floor plan and measurement views; 6 months free hosting; Mattertag hotspots; VR-ready.
- **Zillow 3D Home tours** — free Zillow hosting, ranks listings higher.
- **Drone photography & video** — FAA Part 107 legal aerials, airspace-managed near Harry Reid International.
- **Floor plans** — schematic 2D, colored living spaces, 3D and CAD files; 48 hr delivery as PDF.
- **Virtual staging** — photorealistic furniture added to empty-room HDR photos.
- **Twilight / blue-hour photography** — dramatic warm-lit exteriors.
- **Walk-through video & social reels** — MLS walk-through and 9:16 reels.
- **Google Business View / Street View 360** — 360 tours published to Google Maps and your Business Profile.
- **Commercial real estate photography** — offices, retail, restaurants, industrial, hospitality; extended licensing.
- **As-built surveys & construction documentation** — Matterport reality capture, Matterpak/BIM exports, progress imagery.
- **Vacation rental photography** — Airbnb & Vrbo listing imagery that converts.

## Pricing summary (USD, residential unless noted; full detail at /pricing/)
- HDR photos: from $110 (10 photos) up to $220 (71–90 photos); à-la-carte +$5/photo.
- Bundled packages: Glitz & Glam $200, Neon Skyline (drone) $250, City Never Sleeps (Matterport) $400.
- Matterport 3D: $225 (≤1,500 sq ft) → $350 (≤4,000 sq ft); +$55 per additional 1,000 sq ft.
- Floor plans: $120–$175 (up to 5,000 sq ft); over 5,000 sq ft custom quote.
- Virtual staging: $25/photo, $30/panoramic 360.
- Drone add-on, twilight (+$100), rush delivery (+$40), sky replacement (+$25/3) available.
- Commercial HDR: $210 (5 photos) → $840 (20 photos).
- Google "Get Me On Google" package: $500 (10 HDR photos + express 360 tour, posted to Google Business Profile).

## Service area
Las Vegas Valley (primary, no travel fee): Las Vegas, Henderson, Summerlin, North Las Vegas, Boulder City, and all of Clark County — including Anthem, Cadence, Inspirada, Lake Las Vegas, MacDonald Highlands, Seven Hills, Centennial Hills, Spring Valley, Skye Canyon.
Extended radius (quoted case by case): Mesquite NV, Pahrump NV, Moapa Valley, Overton, Logandale, Searchlight; St. George UT; Kingman AZ, Bullhead City AZ, Laughlin NV.

## Turnaround & terms
- Standard delivery: HDR photos and 3D tours in 24–48 hours; floor plans in 48 hours.
- Rush next-morning delivery available (+$40).
- Cancellation: 24 hours notice to avoid the $35 trip fee (same fee if the property is not shoot-ready).
- Payment: due on delivery.
- Usage rights: client receives rights to use photos for real estate marketing until the property sells; extended licensing available for long-term campaigns.
- FAA drone compliance: all aerial work is flown by an FAA Part 107 certified pilot with airspace authorization.
- Nevada sales tax: photography services are not subject to Nevada sales tax (per NRS 372.050).
